sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B tensor-level abliterated, vision tower and MTP head untouched. 0% over-refusal on XSTest, 0-6% refusal across the A/B suite, no measurable capability loss. Full mmproj vision, tool calling and thinking, 262K context.
